channel.title: The San Jose Source
channel.description: San José decisions, public money, and what happens next.

item.title: San José revises $11.7M rent-help plan after HUD didn't approve it
item.description: The City's revised plan for $11.7 million in 2021 federal rent-help money goes to a Dec. 1 hearing, plus an affordable-housing tax break and a payroll-system extension.

item.title: San José data center rules would charge $50,000 per megawatt
item.description: The proposed data center rules carry two new fees and a staff revenue estimate. No Council meeting this week; the Dec. 1 agenda is out.

item.title: San José wastewater bid comes in 15% over estimate; staff cite limited competition and a construction surge
item.description: Two wastewater plant contracts, one bid 15% over the City's estimate, and a proposed pause on data center approvals.

item.title: San José’s fire stations and police training center: target dates, budgets and opening plans
item.description: What the City first planned for three Measure T fire stations and the police training center, and where each stands today.

item.title: Council approves up to $6.9M fee waiver and $5.7M housing loan; police recruiting overtime runs $631,986 over budget
item.description: What the Council decided from Sept. 15 to Oct. 6, and why the Police Department’s recruiting overtime ran over budget.
